fields.FIR_Description: During the evening of 2025-02-20, around 20:25, the complainant discovered that a gas stove and utensils had been taken from a place near Mullai Puram Parking Area in Thanjavur, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-02-24. Sudha Kannan reported the matter orally at Thanjavur Town PS; the contact number given was 9000000349. Janani Krishnan (9000000357) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Mathan Raman (9000000187), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. Mohan Kumar (mobile 9000000464) was named as a possible person of interest. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Items reportedly taken while the premises were unattended.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, parking area, witness, mobile number, associate, suspect, evening
